data.theme: Code of Business Conduct — The Code You Would Be Willing to Live By
data.deliverable: Build your own 5-point professional Code of Business Conduct. For each principle, include one real-world workplace situation showing what that principle means in action. Do not copy or rewrite an existing company’s COBC. Build something you would personally be willing to follow and be held accountable for.
